title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
summary_full: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.
